newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla fed cattle not enough to test - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla fed cattle not enough to test - USDA.

text.p: Trade slow in the Panhandle area Thursday, USDA said. Slaughter steers and heifers not well tested. Feedlots reporting light inquiry from buyers.

Sales reported on 300 slaughter steers; 100,200 head confirmed for the week to date which includes 60 loads or 2,000 head of CME cattle delivered to area packing plants, 16,800 formulated and 1,900 previously contracted cattle to be shipped this week.
Note - all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1100-1150 lbs 68.00.
Confirmed - 300 Week Ago - None Year Ago - 5,400
Wk to date - 100,200 Week Ago - 103,300 Year Ago - 82,700
